changes.text: View separate Studio and Unity Integration Package changelogs from the version menu or server list, and copy either link from the server list.
Restore changelog links using the updated documentation manifest.
Choose whether to launch Harken Hub when the Windows installer closes, with the option checked by default.
Automatically compare GitHub and OSS download speeds before new Hub updates or Studio downloads, and prefer the faster source.
Resume interrupted downloads from the original source, including after restarting Hub. If that source remains unavailable, switch sources and restart the download with a visible notice.
Keep dialogs within the current screen's available area, including when moving between displays.
Scroll long messages, paths, file lists and integration forms inside dialogs while keeping action buttons visible. Messages, status details and summaries can be selected and copied.

releases.introduction: The first open-source release of Harken Hub is here. Try it out and share your feedback.

changes.text: Download and install Harken Studio through Hub to explore and test its audio authoring features.
Install and manage the Unity Integration Package through Hub to try and test Harken integration in your Unity projects.
